title: Schedules
description: Run a prompt on a timetable while the app is open. Each run works on its own, with only the tools you allow, and stops at the limits you set.
unattendedNote: Runs have nobody watching. A tool that needs your approval is denied and listed under "Blocked on" in the run history. Runs happen while Flint is open; a run missed while it was closed follows the task's catch-up setting.
emptyHint: Create one to have a prompt run every morning, on weekdays, or at the times you pick.
unavailable: Scheduled tasks are only available in the desktop app.

list.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its run history will be removed. Conversations it created stay in your chat list.

run.blockedOnHint: These tool calls needed approval nobody could give, so they were denied.

editor.name: Name
editor.promptPlaceholder: Summarise what changed in the repo since yesterday.
editor.promptHint: Stored as plain text. Do not paste keys or passwords here; provider keys are read from your provider settings.
editor.cronHint: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. Example: 0 9 * * 1-5
editor.cronNeedsOne: These times need more than one expression, so they cannot be edited as a single cron line.
editor.folderHint: The run reads and works in this folder.
editor.profileHint: Optional. A profile name from the project's agent.toml.
editor.toolsHint: Only these tools are available to the run. Anything else is not offered to the model.
editor.toolNeedsApproval: Needs approval, so it is denied unless the task may write in its own worktree.
editor.writeReadOnlyHint: Nothing is edited and no command that changes files is approved.
editor.writeWorktreeHint: Edits are made in a fresh git worktree on their own branch, never in the folder itself.
editor.budgetsHint: Every run stops at the first of these. They are required.
editor.onBlockEnd: Deny it and end the run

errors.promptRequired: Write what the task should do.
